articles.title: Celia Murphy, 78, Church Organist
articles.deck: Friends remember Celia Murphy for the many years of service to Upper Commons.
body: Celia Murphy died in April at home on Crane Lane, at the age of 78. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Upper Commons.

Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Bellwood Chapel in his or her name. Born in Upper Commons in the years after the war, Celia Murphy spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
